title: `metricName` in trigger metadata is removed — the HPA metric name changes

detection.reason: checked on the ScaledObject/ScaledJob triggers the agent projects (trigger type + metadata KEY names, never values) — a key supplied through a TriggerAuthentication or an environment variable is not a metadata key and is not scanned

quote: **General**: Remove deprecated `metricName` from trigger metadata section (#4899)
remediation: From 2.12 a `metricName` key in trigger metadata is ignored and KEDA names the HPA's external metric itself. On each trigger named, remove the key and update anything that reads the HPA metric by its old custom name (dashboards, alerts on `kube_horizontalpodautoscaler_*` metric labels, scripts). Scaling itself continues.
verifyCommand: kubectl get scaledobjects.keda.sh,scaledjobs.keda.sh -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | . as $o | .spec.triggers[]? | select((.metadata // {}) | has("metricName")) | "\($o.kind) \($o.metadata.namespace // "-")/\($o.metadata.name) trigger=\(.type) metricName=\(.metadata.metricName)"'  # each row loses its custom HPA metric name on the hop

title: Admission webhook rejects `metricType: Utilization` on a non-resource trigger

detection.reason: checked on the trigger's own metricType and type as projected (metricTypeClass = resource|external / metricType)

quote: error trigger type is Utilization, but it needs to be AverageValue or Value for external metrics
remediation: `Utilization` only exists for the cpu and memory resource metrics. Each trigger named sets it on an external metric and is rejected by the 2.12 webhook on its next update: change `metricType` to `AverageValue` (per-pod) or `Value` (whole-workload).
verifyCommand: kubectl get scaledobjects.keda.sh,scaledjobs.keda.sh -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | . as $o | .spec.triggers[]? | select(.metricType == "Utilization" and .type != "cpu" and .type != "memory") | "\($o.kind) \($o.metadata.namespace // "-")/\($o.metadata.name) trigger=\(.type)"'  # each row is rejected by the 2.12 webhook on its next update

title: Admission webhook rejects a TriggerAuthentication whose `podIdentity.identityId` is set but empty

detection.reason: the projection records that identityId is set, not whether its value is the empty string

quote: identityid of PodIdentity should not be empty. If it's set, identityId has to be different than \"\"
remediation: An explicitly empty `spec.podIdentity.identityId: ""` is rejected by the 2.12 webhook on the next update of the TriggerAuthentication. Remove the key (to use the operator's identity) or set the client ID of the user-assigned identity.
verifyCommand: kubectl get triggerauthentications.keda.sh,clustertriggerauthentications.keda.sh -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.podIdentity.identityId == "") | "\(.kind) \(.metadata.namespace // "-")/\(.metadata.name)"'  # each row carries an empty identityId
